CINDER@cleanuptoken.name: CleanupCentr CINDER
CINDER@cleanuptoken.description: CINDER connects NFT cleanup with the CleanupCentr game economy on WAX. Players earn CINDER by burning approved NFTs through Incinerators, then spend it to recharge personal and farm energy.

TRASH@cleanuptoken.name: CleanupCentr TRASH
TRASH@cleanuptoken.description: TRASH is the Incinerator fuel token in CleanupCentr on WAX. It supports the Burn Center gameplay loop: fuel an Incinerator, burn approved NFTs, and produce CINDER for the wider game economy.

TOMATOE@maestrobeatz.name: CleanupCentr TOMATOE
TOMATOE@maestrobeatz.description: TOMATOE is a farming resource in CleanupCentr on WAX. Players earn it through configured crop rewards and use it for eligible shop items and blend recipes, connecting harvests with farming supplies and progression.

BANANAZ@maestrobeatz.name: CleanupCentr BANANAZ
BANANAZ@maestrobeatz.description: BANANAZ is a blend ingredient in CleanupCentr on WAX. Supported recipes, including EcoFusion Compost, use BANANAZ alongside other required tokens and NFTs to create farming supplies.
